artwork.derivation: Main SVG artwork preserves source path/shape/text/viewBox data, with namespace and explicit source-like monospace fallback. The native recipe merges a root fallback/color style without duplicate attributes and materializes the retained non-scaling-stroke rule on 10 TOC mini diagrams. All original SVG files remain separately pinned.

tocCorners.source: Four 12 px native HTML corner spans on each of 10 TOC cards; no duplicate overlays on the framed main SVGs.
tocCorners.meter: The four existing registration paths remain byte-exact inside the embedded source SVG; no additional meter overlay.

behavior.navigation: 11 chapters align their start;31 figures align their center; active nearest figure updates the page query; home removes that query. Keyboard arrows cycle figures and0–9 select chapters00–09;E adds one model event andR resets.
behavior.eventStream: Independent deterministic example using the source 72/16/12 event split, 120–1519 token quantities, 260–680 ms cadence, 64-event bound and 10,000-credit grants. Ledger, meter and credits share one model while admitted; numerical/random histories are not byte-equivalent to source.
behavior.construction: Independently authored per-path construction from public timing facts: threshold 0.4 for figures at a 1.3 pace, source stroke/fill/text groups and cubic easing;TOC threshold 0.15 with the isIntersecting predicate and a 110 ms DOM-order batch stagger. Once seen, it does not restart. Actual nativeSVG DOM forwarding is a future gate; asset-only DOM falls back to static artwork.

resources.canvasOptIn: Only RenderTarget.canvas and explicit canvasMotion; export/thumbnail always frozen.
resources.legacyRule: Any mounted canvas[data-study-source], including static legacy still canvases and HERO-016, conservatively blocks all SVG/film automatic motion. DOM/attribute/scroll changes revoke admission and every model paint rechecks the gate. The legacy pool is never mutated and no fake canvas/lease is created.
resources.inactive: Inactive actors hold their SVG snapshot and unsubscribe from model updates. Event timer exists only while a real admitted member is present. Explicit user event/reset is a bounded state action.
resources.movie: One genuine cross-origin iframe may be retained paused. Its browser-owned media decoder is not observable through the old HTMLVideoElement decoder gate; it joins this module Preview admission and is inert when not admitted. Zero owned GL does not mean zero browser/other-study work.
resources.mixedBoard: Conservative mounted-canvas blocking restricts automatic SVG motion on mixed legacy boards. Existing 60 legacy renderer quality evidence is not newly rerun or relabeled by these 36 groups.

differences: Adjacent explanatory paragraphs are independently authored source-grounded summaries; original titles and SVG diagram text remain credited. Native line counts and full scroll extent differ.

Original film is a genuine third-party iframe. Its browser-owned decoder is outside the old HTMLVideoElement gate; it joins this module’s conservative two-Preview gate. One active iframe is declared; no zero-browser-resource claim.
Any canvas[data-study-source], including HERO-016, conservatively blocks all new SVG/iframe automatic motion. No legacy pool mutation or fake lease.
